title: Logarithmic derivative lower bound
statement: Let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. Suppose $p,p_c$ are real numbers with $0<p<1$, $0\le p_c\le1$, and $p\le p_c$, and the biased-minus probability polynomial of $f$ has value $1/2$ at $p_c$. Then the derivative at $p$ of the logarithm of that polynomial is at least $1/(2p)$.
